accessibility.summary: Parking, restrooms, concessions, water fountains, ATMs, closed captioning, and seating areas are accessible to guests with disabilities. Most handicap parking spaces are in Terrapin Trail Garage (Lot 6), the shortest walk to the arena through Gate E, and placards or plates must be displayed.

ticketPickup.summary: The Terrapin Ticket Office is on the second level of the XFINITY Center and is open Monday through Friday, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. (301-314-7070). For basketball games, will call opens two hours before the game at the ticket office at Gate A on the second level. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.
